text: Assumption: Resource cleanup takes place upon object destruction — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Resource cleanup takes place upon object destruction — is this correct?
norm: resource cleanup takes place upon object destruction
assumption: Resource cleanup takes place upon object destruction.
rationale: The payload contains no destructor specification for unfinished streaming sessions; these are presumably implicitly discarded.

original.text: Annahme: Ressourcenbereinigung bei Objektzerstörung — trifft das zu?
original.rationale: Der Payload enthält keine Destruktor-Spezifikation für unvollendete Streaming-Sitzungen; diese dürften implizit verworfen werden.
